name: adaptyv-bio
description: Grounded workflows for preparing, estimating, submitting, and monitoring protein experiments through Adaptyv Bio's hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and manage protein experiments with review gates
interface.longDescription: An OpenAI-authored integration for Adaptyv Bio's hosted MCP server. Estimate and prepare protein experiments, create reviewable drafts, explicitly approve submission and commercial transitions, and monitor status and results without collapsing real-world actions into a single step.
defaultPrompt: List my recent Adaptyv Bio experiments and summarize their current statuses without changing anything.
Estimate the cost of this protein experiment, then show me the proposed draft payload for review.
Review this Adaptyv Bio draft or quote and explain the next approval step without taking it.
